entities.name: Irene Solà
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Irene Solà Sáez is a Catalan writer and artist. She has exhibited her work at the CCCB in Barcelona and the Whitechapel Gallery in London. Her first book of poems, Bèstia won the 2012 Amadeu Oller Prize and her novel Els dics, the 2017 Documenta Prize.
